cases.name: The user successfully carried out personalized settings for the store details and completed the verification for tab switching interception.
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Customize shop

steps.desc:
1. Curator into My shop

2. Click the Customize shop edit button

3. Enter the correct store name, store description, upload avatar

4. Click the Save button

5. Click "Confirm" button
steps.result: Curator successfully customized the store information

steps.desc: 6. Edit profile, and enter a combination of lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens in the store address and click "Save"
steps.result: Saved successfully, the store URL is a combination of lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens

steps.desc: 7. Click to enter the "Customize shop" page. Then, under the "Storefront", "Social", and "Style" tabs, edit the content and switch between them.
steps.result:
7. If there are any modifications made to the content within the tab, when you switch to that tab, a prompt will appear:
Leave this page?
Any unsaved changes will be lost if you continue.
[CTA]Leave without saving
[CTA]Stay on page

steps.desc: 8. Click "Leave without saving" and "Stay on page" respectively
steps.result: 8. After clicking "Leave without saving", the current changes will be discarded and the user will be switched to the desired tab. After clicking "Stay on page", you will remain on the current tab.

steps.desc: 9. Edit the "shop" section again. This time, in the "Storefront", "Social", and "Style" tabs, do not edit any content and switch between them.
steps.result: 9. After making any modifications to the content within the tab, switching to another tab is smooth and natural.
